instructions: Unread mail that needs a reply from me: written by a person rather than sent in bulk, asking me something or waiting on me. Skip newsletters, notifications and receipts.
Invoices, payment reminders and anything that says a payment is due or overdue. Urgent when it is already past its due date.
Newsletters and promotional senders I keep receiving and never open - worth unsubscribing from. Name the sender and how many arrived lately.
Pull requests where my review is requested and I have not reviewed yet. Say how long each has waited.
My own open pull requests whose checks are failing.
Issues and pull requests where I was mentioned or asked a question that I have not answered.
Merge requests waiting on my review or approval. Say how long each has waited.
Failed pipelines on my own open merge requests or on the default branch of projects I work in.
Issues newly assigned to me, or assigned to me and changed by somebody else since I last looked.
My issues that are past their due date or marked blocked.
Jira issues newly assigned to me, or assigned to me and commented on by somebody else.
My Jira issues past their due date, or blocked.
Direct messages and mentions of me that nobody - me included - has answered yet.
Chats and channel messages mentioning me that I have not answered yet.
Pages and comments where I was mentioned or a question waits on me.
New errors and regressions in my projects. Urgent when one is affecting many users.
Open incidents assigned to me or my escalation policy, not yet acknowledged.
My open deals with no activity for a week, or closing this week.
Conversations assigned to me that are waiting on a reply.
My tasks that are due today or overdue.
My tasks that are due today or overdue.
My tasks that are due today or overdue.
